$description: Living Journal design system — 'the paper training journal's organization rendered in living ink'. Paper surfaces hold still; only the ink moves, and every stroke is dead straight. Authored 2026-07-18 for swole; reusable across projects.

color.$description: Two contrast tiers per accent, per WCAG 2.1. The base token (inkSecondary/semantic) clears 3:1 against both page and card and is correct for large text (≥18px, or ≥14px at font-weight ≥700), icons, strokes, borders, and other graphical objects (non-text contrast, WCAG 1.4.11). For text below that size/weight threshold, use the paired '-text' token (inkSecondaryText/semanticText) instead, which clears 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3, body text) against both page and card. A base token used directly on body text is the defect this pairing exists to fix — do not reintroduce it. Dark-theme '-text' values alias their base token unchanged, since dark already clears 4.5:1 with one value; the pairing exists in dark too only so a consumer can always reach for the '-text' variant without a per-theme branch.

light.$description: LIGHT · PAPER — warm cream page, near-black ink.

card.$description: Raised paper surface; one cream step above page.

ink.$description: Primary text and drawn marks. Warm dark brown — mirrors the dark theme's page background, so light and dark reflect one another.

inkSecondary.$description: Secondary text, equipment gray in figures. 3:1 tier — large text/icons/graphics only; for body text use inkSecondaryText (see color.$description).

inkSecondaryText.$description: Body-text-safe variant of inkSecondary. 4.5:1 on page (4.546:1) and card (4.818:1).

hairline.$description: Card borders and rules: ink at ~14% alpha.

semantic.$description: STRICTLY semantic green: done marks, PR/progression, form-safety (spine), signature accent rule. Never decorative. 3:1 tier — large text/icons/graphics only; for body text use semanticText (see color.$description). semanticText inherits the same STRICTLY-semantic constraint; it does not relax it.

semanticText.$description: Body-text-safe variant of semantic, for the rare case semantic green marks body-size text (e.g. an inline status word). 4.5:1 on page (4.978:1) and card (5.275:1). Same STRICTLY semantic usage rule as semantic.

dark.$description: DARK · LAMPLIT PAPER — the journal by lamplight: deep warm espresso, cream ink. Never blue-black.

inkSecondary.$description: Secondary text: warm taupe, never cool gray. Already clears 4.5:1 (6.488:1 page / 5.798:1 card).

inkSecondaryText.$description: Aliases inkSecondary unchanged — dark already clears 4.5:1, so no separate value is needed. Kept as a distinct token so a consumer always reaches for '-text' for body text regardless of theme.

dialTrack.$description: Empty track of rest dial / progress strokes.

semantic.$description: Semantic green brightened one step for AA (~6.5:1) on card brown. Already clears 4.5:1 (7.307:1 page / 6.530:1 card).

semanticText.$description: Aliases semantic unchanged — dark already clears 4.5:1. Same STRICTLY semantic usage rule as semantic; kept as a distinct token for API uniformity with light.

display.$description: Fraunces (OFL) — every numeral that matters (loads, reps, timers) and screen titles. Fallback Georgia, serif.

body.$description: Inter (OFL) — labels, body copy, navigation. Fallback system-ui, sans-serif.

label.$description: Small-caps letterspaced labels (section headers, box headers, nav).

stroke.$description: Drawn-mark weights, inherited from the line-art animation rig (512px canvas reference).

figureBody.$description: Ink body strokes in exercise figures, round caps/joins.

accentRule.$description: The signature straight accent rule (e.g., under a screen title). One per screen.

tab.$description: Week-strip journal tabs — all seven identical.

motion.$description: Ink moves like a spring — and ink is always straight. Paper surfaces hold still; only drawn marks animate. Clean geometry only: straight rules and perfect arcs, no wobble, no irregular paths.

spring.$description: Press/settle curve for steppers and small controls (overshoot-and-settle).

drawOn.$description: Stroke-draw reveals (accent rule, set-check) via dash-offset; ease-out.

drain.$description: Rest dial/bar ink drains in real time on a perfect arc or straight bar.

breathe.$description: Soft scale pulse (≤2%) for the single primary CTA when idle; subtle.

principles.$value: 1) Paper never bounces — surfaces do not translate/scale on interaction. 2) Ink does the moving: draws itself on, drains, checks in. 3) Every animated mark is straight or a perfect arc. 4) One breathing element per screen maximum. 5) Semantic green may move; decoration may not exist.

reducedMotion.$description: Resolution contract for prefers-reduced-motion (web) / a disabled system animator scale (Android, ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE=0, read via rememberInkMotionEnabled()). Applies to every current and future animated token.
reducedMotion.$value: Governing principle: no element's meaning may depend on having seen it animate — any new animated token must declare its static end state at definition time. Under reduced motion, every animated token resolves to that end state immediately, with no transition: drawOn (accent rule, set-check) -> renders fully drawn, not mid-stroke or unstarted. Count-up numerals -> render at final value (no count-up token or animation exists in this codebase yet; when one is added, it must honor this rule from the start, not retrofit it). DrawnCheck -> renders checked, i.e. the same fully-drawn end state as drawOn. breathe -> holds still at 1x scale, no pulse. An animation that is merely shortened in duration does not satisfy this if it is also set to repeat indefinitely — an infinite-iteration animation must stop iterating, not just iterate faster; and an animation without a forwards fill must actually rest at its intended end value once stopped, not snap back to its start.

iconography.$description: Line-art in figure stroke style: round caps, ink color, no fills. The 35 exercise Lottie animations are first-class brand elements — give them framed 'form panel' homes, never thumbnails.

navStyle.$value: outlined line icons, small-caps labels, active = ink-filled + small dot beneath

status.$description: STATUS EXTENSION — operational surfaces only — not for the swole app. Amends the 'no second accent' rule for dashboards that must show failing/at-risk states (e.g. the charlie-work fleet dashboard, which vendors these values). The swole app never consumes this group. Color never encodes state alone (pair with a word or glyph); healthy states stay ink/gray; green stays semantic 'done' only. Every text value clears 4.5:1 on its theme's page and card, except dark danger on card (4.64:1, still above 4.5:1). Chart series clear 3:1 vs card. Deliberately a sibling of 'color' (not nested) so the swole Kotlin TokenParityTest, which reads only 'color', is unaffected.

light.$description: Light theme status values — operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

danger.$description: Failing/blocked. Text-safe: 6.07:1 page, 6.43:1 card. Operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

warn.$description: At-risk/degraded. Text-safe: 5.04:1 page, 5.34:1 card. Operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

dark.$description: Dark theme status values — operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

danger.$description: Failing/blocked. Text-safe: 5.19:1 page, 4.64:1 card. Operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

warn.$description: At-risk/degraded. Text-safe: 7.34:1 page, 6.56:1 card. Operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

chart.$description: Chart series palette — operational surfaces only — not for the swole app. Series 1 and 2 reference existing color tokens; series 3 is tan. All clear 3:1 against card (graphical objects, WCAG 1.4.11). Series must also be distinguishable by label/direct annotation, never color alone.

series1.$description: Ref color.light.ink (16.55:1 page, 17.54:1 card). operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

series2.$description: Ref color.light.inkSecondary (3.94:1 page, 4.17:1 card). operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

series3.$description: Tan series. 3.84:1 page, 4.07:1 card. Operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

series1.$description: Ref color.dark.ink (14.26:1 page, 12.74:1 card). operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

series2.$description: Ref color.dark.inkSecondary (6.49:1 page, 5.80:1 card). operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

series3.$description: Tan series. 8.75:1 page, 7.82:1 card. Operational surfaces only — not for the swole app.

dashboardLocal.$description: LOCAL, charlie-work-only: not vendored from swole, never compared by swole_drift, never to be upstreamed as-is. Spacing and type-size scales for the operational dashboard layout.

spacing.$description: Spacing scale in px (derived from the Living Journal reference).

typeSize.$description: Type-size scale in px (derived from the Living Journal reference).
